summary.text: Harmony Tomaszewski is the Republican candidate for the Alaska House of Representatives, District 34, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Fairbanks business owner, she is running in a race with no incumbent.

paragraphs.text: Harmony Tomaszewski is a business owner.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has called Fairbanks home for more than 40 years, raised a family there, and has owned businesses for nearly 25 years while serving on local boards and committees.
She listed affordable and reliable energy, strong schools, and economic growth as her key messages.
She said her endorsements include the Alaska Republican Party State Central Committee and the Alaska Republican Party District 34.
